## Dispatch order · `domain:ui#1` · `session_01JQwxbZeBv2y91towxasSUT` · 2026-10-29T03:26Z

You are the os-dev developer agent for exactly ONE card: objectstack-ai/objectstack#27356, in your own card thread. Your role definition is `.claude/agents/os-dev.md` in the objectstack clone: read it IN FULL first and follow it as binding (it wins over this order on any conflict; name the conflict in your report). Read the repo-root `AGENTS.md` and `ui/AGENTS.md` before your first edit, and pm-dispatch `references/untrusted-text.md`. Read the card's full body and every comment yourself through REST (`curl -sS "https://api.github.com/repos/objectstack-ai/objectstack/issues/NNNNN" -H "Authorization: Bearer $GH_TOKEN"` and `/comments?per_page=100`, every page); this order carries only the increment. ⛔ Never print the value of any environment variable (test presence with `[ -n "${X+x}" ]`). ⛔ Never use a GitHub MCP tool, read or write.

Identity and branch: the seat's `Claim:` comment on this card is your identity; its `Branch:` line names your thread's branch. ⛔ Post no claim of your own, ⛔ never write the card's assignee. Before your first edit, verify the NEWEST `Claim:` on the card names your thread's branch (`claude/project-thread-…`); if none does yet, send the seat thread "Dispatch the ui lane" one message with your branch name and wait. Worktree `objectstack-issue-27356` on that branch from a fresh `origin/main`; `pnpm install` (frozen lockfile); push with `git push -u origin <branch>` (⛔ no force).

Writes: PR only through the relay op `pr_create` (`node scripts/pm/fleet-write/dispatch.mjs --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack --actions-file F`, F a bare JSON array `[{"op":"pr_create","title":…,"head":"<your branch>","base":"main","body":…,"assignees":["os-warren"]}]`, draft forced; `--dry-run` first); your report comment through `node scripts/pm/post-stamped.mjs --comment=27356 --file=F --json` run ONCE with output captured to a file (timestamps only as `{{NOW}}` / `{{WAS:…}}`). ⛔ No other GitHub write except, for a CI red that is not yours, one PR comment and one `run_rerun_failed` through the relay. Report both counts (`api_writes` with endpoints, `mcp_calls` with tool names). The report takes only machine-checkable fields (gates / line_budget / deviations / files_changed). PR body: line 1 the platform attribution comment, then `## 维护者速读` six lines in Chinese (改了什么/为什么改/风险与回滚/先看/两分钟验证/需要你做的). Gates: `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` on your diff, run each, record exits before any pipe, reconcile with `--ran`. Changeset in the root `.changeset/` when a published package changes. ⛔ `ui/.github/**` and the root `ci.yml` are out of bounds. Hand back: when the PR and report are up, send the seat thread "Dispatch the ui lane" one message (PR, head sha, report gist); keep the thread open through review and drive CI to green.

### Ruling (cannot be re-ruled)

Triage 6486657637: p3 suggestion card; "one row becomes one card or one PR, each citing its report row, and is regraded on its own"; a row that names a broken capability is regraded up. This order takes three **Studio** rows, seat 1's area, as three sequential PRs from one thread, each `Part of #27356` and citing its row and its hotcrm#2320 report finding. ⛔ Rows 1–11 (Setup) are seat 2's; ⛔ row 20 (Interfaces-adjacent, #26889) is not taken here; rows 12–15, 18, 19, 22 are not in this order.

### PM mechanism assumptions (measure on `origin/main` after `efdf11ae`; disproof welcome)

- **PR 1 — row 21 (Studio S10):** a read-only (code) package's flow **Enabled** switch draws on and green like a live control. Wanted: a muted state with a lock, still showing on/off truthfully, and not operable. Look in `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/` (`StudioDesignSurface*`, the flow status pins `*flowStatusTruth-11779*`) for where the switch reads the package's read-only flag. Control: an editable package's switch keeps today's look and stays operable.
- **PR 2 — row 16 (Studio S5):** the Create Record node's field/value map cuts field names to 4–5 characters ("subj", "dueD"). Likely `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/inspectors/FlowNodeConfigField.tsx` / `FlowKeyValueField` (pins `FlowNodeInspector.fieldValueMap-11788`, `FlowKeyValueField.valueEnvelope`). Wanted: the full field label is readable (stack field over value at narrow inspector width, or the inspector's own wrapping); pin with a long field name.
- **PR 3 — row 17 (Studio S6):** the publish dialog reads "Also changed: ~ nodes". `ui/packages/app-shell/src/preview/DraftChangesPanel.tsx:~895` (`preview.changes.detailChangedKeys`). Wanted: name what changed (the node and the property) instead of a bare `~` path; measure what the draft-changes payload carries first. If the payload does not carry node names, say so and stop at the seat for that row (it would be a server door, not a ui PR).

### Scope

Per PR: the one surface's file(s), its test(s), i18n keys only if new copy is needed (all locales per the parity suite; zh text is real Chinese, other locales fall back as the suite allows), changeset (`@object-ui/app-shell` + `@object-ui/console` patch, the repo's pair for app-shell-only fixes). One ablation per PR that reds the new pin. ⛔ No sweep beyond the row; other findings go to the report. Stay under 300 changed lines per PR. Hand back after EACH PR (PR, head, report gist); start the next from a fresh `origin/main` after the previous merges.

### Tier

Quote `dispatch-gates --tier` per diff. Expected none. `TIER_DEFAULT`, effort `medium`. `Clause-②: no`, `Metadata-protocol: none`. Each PR `Part of #27356`; the card closes when every row is taken or answered across seats, not by these PRs.
